title: Reserved-pool onboarding: customer scripting and SLA negotiation workflow
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a repeatable, customer-facing workflow and internal playbook for onboarding enterprise customers into reserved GPU pools. Scope: intake questionnaire to capture throughput/SLOs and workload fingerprint, automated GPU-class recommendation (latency-sensitive vs throughput-oriented), SLA negotiation script for commercial teams, and a set of default scaling policies (pre-warm, burst credits, soft-limit degrade path). Deliverables: intake template, decision matrix for GPU family (A100/H100/RTX-class/etc.), an engineering acceptance checklist, and telemetry gates for production handoff.

acceptance_criteria: Intake questionnaire covers SLA targets (p50/p95/p99), steady and burst throughput, and data residency
Automated GPU-class recommendation returns a suggested GPU family and quantization profile for 90% of sample workloads in 24-hour test
Negotiation script and contract clause templates reviewed by Legal and Sales
Engineering acceptance checklist completed and canary run executed with alpha customer and telemetry gates passing for 3 consecutive days
decision_log: Chosen SLA bands: Gold (p99 < 150ms, reserved throughput + 20% burst), Silver (p99 < 300ms), Bronze (best-effort with pre-warm option)

GPU mapping heuristic: latency-sensitive -> H100 family; throughput/packing -> A100 family; dev/internal/offload -> RTX-class. Document includes fallback to smaller model/quantized variant for constrained pools.
Scaling policy: target autoscale window 60s for steady growth, 10s pre-warm trigger for scheduled bursts, and configurable burst-credit pool consumed before fallback to hosted routing.
Telemetry gates: request-level tags, token-level cost attribution, model-variant failover counts, and p99 latency trending required for production sign-off.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Overcommitting GPUs to Gold SLAs increases reserved cost exposure. Mitigation: include a cost-sharing band and a minimum-commit term; surface projected monthly cost during negotiation.
Risk: Burst behavior can destabilize co-tenants in shared infra. Mitigation: set per-pool shaping and enforce burst-credit spend limits; require capacity-concierge signoff for >2x bursts.
Risk: Contract clauses may delay legal sign-off. Mitigation: provide pre-approved clause templates and a fast-track review lane for strategic accounts.
